author: Forbes
description:
One of the biggest reasons startups fail isn’t the product, it’s tension between founders.

Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree and entrepreneur Shiv Bhakta shares why strong leadership starts with alignment and how helping teams succeed through clarity, competence and collaboration is key to building a lasting company.
title: Why Startups Fail: Climate Tech Founder Shiv Bhakta

description:
Success isn’t just about how fast you move. It’s about how long you can keep going.
